aboutGame.title: What is Fields of Mistria?
paragraphs: Fields of Mistria is a cozy farming and life simulation RPG developed by NPC Studio. Players inherit a damaged farm, rebuild a magical village and create their own peaceful adventure.
The game combines farming, exploration, crafting, mining, friendship and romance systems with charming pixel-art visuals inspired by classic farming RPGs.

finalCta.title: Ready to Master Fields of Mistria?
finalCta.description: From your first farm day to rebuilding the entire village, our community wiki helps you discover every secret, item, character and progression path.

footer.about: Fields of Mistria Wiki is an independent fan-made guide website. It covers farming strategies, villagers, romance routes, quests, items, skills and progression guides. The site is created for players looking for complete game information.
footer.description: Cozy farming life RPG with magic, romance, exploration and village restoration.
